correctness.rationale: Inclusion-exclusion of coprime counts gives the exact a.e. sawtooth identity D_qp(t)=h_q(t)-h_q(pt), where h_q(u)={qu}-{u}. Couple uniform T=(K_p+U)/p to independent V=(K_p+W)/p. On all but at most q-1 grid intervals containing a breakpoint of h_q, |h_q(T)-h_q(V)|<= (q-1)/p; bounded density of h_q(V)-h_q(U) proves the stated uniform CDF error <=2(q-1)/p. Integrate the piecewise affine law for second/fourth limiting moments. For q=3, exact integral over j/(3p)<t<(j+1)/(3p) reduces to sum_j[E_j^5-(E_j-Delta)^5]/[5 Delta(3p)^5]. Splitting p=3m+kappa and residues j=kp+s, s=3a+u shows each branch numerator is a rational polynomial in m of degree at most 6; checking 7 exact nodes per branch therefore proves all m. Independently computed all 14 integer nodes m=0..6 and rational H4 at p=5,7,11,13,17,19,23,29, matching the two stated closed rational branches; independent finite values corroborate the degree-bound proof.
